title: GrowShrinkTag
intro: GrowShrinkTag displays a value with visual indicators for growth (positive) or decline (negative), commonly used for showing percentage changes or trends.
tables: The numeric value to display. Positive values show green/success styling, negative values show red/error styling
Whether to show the directional arrow icon
Content to display before the value
Content to display after the value
Additional CSS classes to apply to the tag
